description: MainActivity.kt for an Android calculator app with voice recognition. Contains UI logic, event handling, and interaction with calculator engine and history management.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Primary activity class managing the calculator UI, voice input, and history drawer.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets content view, configures UI components and event listeners.

methods.name: updateResultBox
methods.description: Updates the TextView displaying the current expression.

methods.name: evaluateAndShowResult
methods.description: Evaluates the current expression, updates result, and records history.

methods.name: wireCalculatorKeypad
methods.description: Binds calculator keypad buttons to append symbols or evaluate expression.

methods.name: setupHistoryPanel
methods.description: Sets up event handlers for showing/hiding the history drawer.

methods.name: showHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Inflates and displays the history drawer UI with animation.

methods.name: hideHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Animates and removes the history drawer UI.

methods.name: populateHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Populates the history drawer with stored calculation entries.

methods.name: updateHistoryPanelIfVisible
methods.description: Refreshes the history list if drawer is visible.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for theme toggling.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches between light and dark themes.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles speech recognition activity result via VoiceSearchBar.
